title: Next week, next summer
goal: Talk about plans with geljek hepde, indiki ýyl and iki günden soň, using -jAk or -ýAr.

intro.text: *geljek hepde* or *indiki hepde* (next week), *indiki ýyl* (next year), *iki günden soň* (in two days, with *-den*). For plans, the present also works: *Ertir Mara gidýärin*. For **will**, use `-jAk`.

exercises.question: How do you say **in two days**?
exercises.explain: The time in the ablative, then *soň*: *iki günden soň*.

exercises.prompt: Next week I'll go to Dashoguz.
accept: Geljek hepde men Daşoguza gitjek.
Indiki hepde men Daşoguza gitjek.
Men [geljek|indiki] hepde Daşoguza gitjek.

reject.why: *gitjek* doesn't say who. Say the subject: *Geljek hepde men Daşoguza gitjek*.
*geljek hepde* takes no ending: **next week** is just *geljek hepde*.

accept: dan

exercises.prompt: Indiki ýyl tomusda biz Türkmenbaşa gitjek.
accept: Next summer we will go to Türkmenbaşy.
Next summer we will go to Turkmenbashi.
We will go to [Türkmenbaşy|Turkmenbashi] next summer.
We are going to go to [Türkmenbaşy|Turkmenbashi] next summer.
Next year in (the) summer we will go to [Türkmenbaşy|Turkmenbashi].
Next year we will go to [Türkmenbaşy|Turkmenbashi] in (the) summer.

exercises.question: Your trip to Mary tomorrow is arranged. Which can you say?
options: Both *Ertir Mara gidýärin* and *Men ertir Mara gitjek*

why.1: The present works for a plan, but so does `-jAk`.
why.2: `-jAk` works, but the present `-ýAr` is also fine for a plan.

exercises.explain: For plans, `-ýAr` and `-jAk` are both fine. For **will**, use `-jAk`.

accept: Men soň jaň etjek.
Soň men jaň etjek.

reject.why: *etjek* doesn't say who. Say the subject: *Men soň jaň etjek*.

exercises.text: The holiday is in two weeks.

accept: Next year Merjen will study in London.
Merjen will study in London next year.
Next year Merjen is going to study in London.
Merjen is going to study in London next year.

exercises.en: Next week we'll have a rest.
exercises.explain: *geljek hepde* is **next week**; *geçen hepde* is **last week**.

accept: Ertir biz Mara gidýäris.
Biz ertir Mara gidýäris.
Ertir Mara gidýäris.
Biz ertir Mara gitjek.
Ertir biz Mara gitjek.

reject.why: With *gitjek*, say who: *Biz ertir Mara gitjek*. Or use the present, whose ending says **we**: *Ertir Mara gidýäris*.

exercises.question: *Tomusda Aşgabatda örän yssy.* When is it very hot?

exercises.prompt: In winter we'll stay at home.
accept: Gyşda biz öýde galjak.
Biz gyşda öýde galjak.

reject.why: *galjak* doesn't say who. Say the subject: *Gyşda biz öýde galjak*.

accept: What will they do on holiday?
What will they do on vacation?
What are they going to do on holiday?
What are they going to do on vacation?
What will they do during the holidays?
